## Testing Mode
RED then GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: Running aws-teardown.sh without --user-approved exits 1 with a clear message; with --user-approved it removes the Lambda, execution role, S3 bucket, and CloudWatch log group.

## Files to create
- `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-teardown.sh` (source)
- `tests/scripts/test-aws-teardown.sh` (test — hyphen-named)

## Implementation: aws-teardown.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

if [[ "${1:-}" != "--user-approved" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: This script permanently deletes AWS resources. Pass --user-approved to confirm." >&2
  exit 1
fi

FUNCTION_NAME=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config review_telemetry.lambda_function_name)
ROLE_NAME=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config review_telemetry.iam_role_name)
BUCKET=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config review_telemetry.bucket_name)
LOG_GROUP=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config review_telemetry.log_group_name)

echo "Deleting resources:"
echo "  Lambda: $FUNCTION_NAME"
echo "  IAM Role: $ROLE_NAME"
echo "  S3 Bucket: $BUCKET"
echo "  CloudWatch Log Group: $LOG_GROUP"

# 1. Lambda function
(aws lambda delete-function --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME" 2>/dev/null) || true

# 2. IAM role — MUST clean inline policies and detach managed policies before delete-role
while IFS= read -r policy_name; do
  [[ -n "$policy_name" ]] || continue
  (aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" --policy-name "$policy_name" 2>/dev/null) || true
done < <(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" --query PolicyNames --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "")

while IFS= read -r policy_arn; do
  [[ -n "$policy_arn" ]] || continue
  (aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" --policy-arn "$policy_arn" 2>/dev/null) || true
done < <(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" --query 'AttachedPolicies[].PolicyArn' --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "")

(aws iam delete-role --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" 2>/dev/null) || true

# 3. S3 bucket (empty first, then delete)
(aws s3 rm "s3://$BUCKET" --recursive 2>/dev/null) || true
(aws s3api delete-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null) || true

# 4. CloudWatch log group
(aws logs delete-log-group --log-group-name "$LOG_GROUP" 2>/dev/null) || true

echo "Teardown complete."
```

chmod +x immediately after creation. The `|| true` on each delete is intentional: "already absent" is not a failure.

## Implementation: test-aws-teardown.sh

Use sandbox-cd pattern + LOG_FILE to record aws invocations:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/assert.sh"

SANDBOX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aws-teardown-test.XXXXXX)
LOG_FILE=$(mktemp /tmp/aws-invocations.XXXXXX)
trap "rm -rf '$SANDBOX'; rm -f '$LOG_FILE'" EXIT

# Create dso stub (read-config fixture)
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX/.claude/scripts"
cat > "$SANDBOX/.claude/scripts/dso" << 'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
case "$2" in
  review_telemetry.lambda_function_name) echo "test-fn" ;;
  review_telemetry.iam_role_name) echo "test-role" ;;
  review_telemetry.bucket_name) echo "test-bucket" ;;
  review_telemetry.log_group_name) echo "test-log" ;;
esac
STUB
chmod +x "$SANDBOX/.claude/scripts/dso"

# aws mock records all invocations; returns 0 by default
cat > "$SANDBOX/aws" << 'AWS_STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo '[]'
AWS_STUB
chmod +x "$SANDBOX/aws"
export PATH="$SANDBOX:$PATH"

# Test 1: no --user-approved → exit 1, no deletes
cd "$SANDBOX"
> "$LOG_FILE"
bash "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-teardown.sh" 2>/dev/null && assert_fail "should exit 1" || true
assert_eq "$(wc -l < "$LOG_FILE")" 0 "no aws calls without --user-approved"

# Test 2: with --user-approved → exit 0, correct order
> "$LOG_FILE"
bash "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-teardown.sh" --user-approved
assert_eq "$?" 0 "should exit 0 with --user-approved"
assert_contains "$(cat "$LOG_FILE")" "list-role-policies" "must list inline policies"
assert_contains "$(cat "$LOG_FILE")" "delete-role" "must call delete-role"
assert_contains "$(cat "$LOG_FILE")" "delete-log-group" "must delete log group"
# Verify list-role-policies appears BEFORE delete-role in log
ROLE_POLICY_LINE=$(grep -n 'list-role-policies' "$LOG_FILE" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
DELETE_ROLE_LINE=$(grep -n 'delete-role ' "$LOG_FILE" | grep -v 'policy' | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
(( ROLE_POLICY_LINE < DELETE_ROLE_LINE )) || assert_fail "list-role-policies must precede delete-role"

# Test 3: mock returns error for lambda delete; should still exit 0
...

print_summary
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] aws-teardown.sh executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-teardown.sh
- [ ] shellcheck passes on aws-teardown.sh
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-teardown.sh
- [ ] shellcheck passes on test-aws-teardown.sh
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-aws-teardown.sh
- [ ] Targeted test passes (all 3 behavioral cases)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-teardown.sh
- [ ] list-role-policies + delete-role-policy appear before delete-role in test log
  Verify: grep 'list-role-policies.*delete-role' tests/scripts/test-aws-teardown.sh || grep -c 'list-role-policies' tests/scripts/test-aws-teardown.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
